description.value: Snowy Village is a Korean dessert cafe chain known for Korean-style shaved ice (bingsu) and other sweet treats, with locations across western Canada including this Richmond outpost. The Alexandra Road location places it in one of the Lower Mainland's most food-rich Korean commercial corridors, making it a potential rest stop for cyclists exploring Richmond's flat, bikeable streets. The franchise operates across BC, Alberta, and Saskatchewan.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 8m; rack at 35m; rack at 43m; stands at 71m.
